fields.statement: Verified at f8fa2173e: go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run '^(TestScriptShard|TestScriptShardEnvError|TestScriptOrder)$' (covers -run TestScriptShard) exit 0, every subtest PASS; gofmt -l cmd/rhiza empty; go vet ./cmd/rhiza exit 0. Diff read: shardNames sorts by recorded time (untimed weigh the median, timed first on ties, then name) and places each on the least-loaded shard, ties to the lower; scriptFiles passes the selection to testscript Files. TestScriptShard asserts: n=4 over testdata/script with script-timings.tsv disjoint and covering every script, each shard longest-first, totals within 15% of the mean; exact greedy placements pinned on fixtures (incl. tie to lower shard and median weight for missing scripts); unset returns all scripts longest first; 0/4, 5/4, x (and 1/0, 1/, /4, 1/4x, -1/4) rejected; TestScriptShardEnvError checks the error names RHIZA_TEST_SHARD with want i/n. Note: the n=4 real-data case checks balance rather than re-deriving the exact greedy assignment, which the fixtures pin. No TODOs or stubs.
